# External design references

Screenshots in this directory are pulled from the upstream Apache
Superset repository as design inspiration for the BeerBeer dashboard.
They are *not* renderings of this project's dashboard.

| File | Source | Notes |
|------|--------|-------|
| `superset_official_dashboard.jpg` | [`apache/superset` @ master](https://github.com/apache/superset/blob/master/docs/static/img/screenshots/dashboard.jpg) | The Sales Dashboard from Superset's README. Reference for KPI + trendline layout, sidebar filters, tabbed dashboards. |
| `superset_official_gallery.jpg`   | [`apache/superset` @ master](https://github.com/apache/superset/blob/master/docs/static/img/screenshots/gallery.jpg) | The chart-type gallery. Reference for which `viz_type`s exist out of the box. |
